claim: Among the three six-point minimal finite models of \(\bigvee_{i=1}^{3}S^1\), direct integral first-homology action is model-dependent. For the complete height-two model \(K_{2,4}\) (and its opposite \(K_{4,2}\)), the \(1782\) continuous self-maps induce exactly \(421\) endomorphisms of \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z^3\), with distinct-action rank profile \(1,84,288,48\) in ranks \(0,1,2,3\). For the third model, whose Hasse graph is \(K_{3,3}\) with one edge deleted, the \(646\) continuous self-maps induce exactly \(113\) endomorphisms, with rank profile \(1,60,48,4\). In both model types an induced \(H_1\)-automorphism occurs if and only if the self-map is a homeomorphism: \(48\) maps for \(K_{2,4}\) and \(4\) maps for \(K_{3,3}\setminus e\).

integrity.claim_scope: complete direct self-map census and induced integral first-homology action census for the three six-point minimal finite models of the three-circle bouquet
integrity.novelty_boundary: the three minimal models and finite-space/order-complex correspondence are prior work; the exact self-map totals, action-set cardinalities, rank profiles, and model-dependence of direct H1 expressivity are the claimed new content
integrity.proof_core: Barmak--Minian's minimal-model classification plus exhaustive order-preserving self-map enumeration and exact graph-chain homology calculation

scientific_limitations: The statement concerns direct continuous self-maps of the three six-point minimal finite models of \(\bigvee^3 S^1\), not larger finite models or subdivisions.
The exact numerical classification is established by complete finite enumeration with a replayable dependency-free verifier.
The literature comparison is targeted and cannot exclude every obscure or unindexed prior enumeration.
title: Direct homology actions distinguish minimal finite models of \(\bigvee^3 S^1\)
